title: 第63章 强渡奇穷河
content_zh:
第63章 强渡奇穷河-《文豪1978：从军旅作家开始》
上一章
存书签
下一章
152毫米加榴炮是目前我军绝对的火炮之王，一颗炮弹下去，一米厚的钢铁混凝土工事直接烟消云散，也省了越南人收尸和火化的功夫，非常的人道。
在拂晓攻击前一栋房子都不能留的命令下，火炮在前，步兵很快就攻下了谅山北区。
一二十年的备战备荒，国内的子弹和炮弹前所未有的充足。
奇穷河北岸的阵地上，三营接手防御工事之后，又在原有的基础上继续加固阵地。战士们修建工事的同时，目光不自觉地望向谅山方向。
万炮的轰鸣声听得清清楚楚，甚至在阵地上能够感受到明显的震感。谅山距离禄平不到二十公里，中间虽然有喀斯特石山，但并没有大山阻隔，所以能听到炮鸣声就不是什么稀奇事儿了。
站在远处光围观，就能感受到谅山越军的绝望。炮弹的冲击波和碎片将一栋栋房子摧毁，将一名名越军撕碎。
从上午开始，谅山方向的炮声就没有断过，只不过下午没有上午集火的时候那么密集。
穷则战术穿插，富则万炮齐发！面对越南北部的雨林，我军现在是又穿插，又齐发！
刘济民看了看谅山方向，又望向后面的禄平县城。禄平县城里浓烟滚滚，时不时传来枪声和炮响。远处的支马公路上，源源不断的汽车将物资运送到前线，又将伤员和战利品往后拉。
偶尔能看到直升机在禄平县城上空徘徊，这对于127师的战士们来说，看到直升机也是新鲜事儿。
第一阶段对直升机的运用并不多，仅限于运送重伤员，或者指挥人员快速转移使用。
宋大根站在阵地上，咧着大嘴笑着说道：“看样子，55军晚上就进谅山吃晚饭，清明就能拿下狗日的河内。”
“老宋，你下来，不要站那么高，小心狙击手！”刘济民喊道！
宋大根笑着跳了下来：“指导员，一时激动我忘了！”
“老宋，小心点没坏处！”
“中！”
“营长来了！”阵地上不知道谁喊了一声，刘济民等人立即过去迎接。

The 152mm howitzer is currently the absolute king of artillery in our army. When a shell is fired, the one-meter-thick steel and concrete fortifications disappear directly into smoke. It also saves the Vietnamese the effort of collecting corpses and cremating them. It is very humane.
Under the order that not a single house should be left before the dawn attack, with artillery in front, the infantry quickly captured the northern district of Lang Son.
After ten or twenty years of preparation for war and famine, domestic bullets and artillery shells have never been more abundant.
On the position on the north bank of the Qiqiong River, the Third Battalion continued to strengthen the position on the original basis after taking over the defenses. While the soldiers were building fortifications, they unconsciously looked towards Lang Son.
The roar of thousands of artillery pieces could be heard clearly, and an obvious vibration could even be felt on the battlefield. Lang Son is less than 20 kilometers away from Luping. Although there are karst mountains in the middle, there are no mountains blocking it, so it is not unusual to hear the sound of cannons.
Standing in the distance and just watching, you can feel the despair of the Lang Son Vietnamese army. The shock waves and fragments of the shells destroyed houses one after another and tore a Vietnamese soldier into pieces.
Since the morning, the sound of artillery fire in the direction of Lang Son has not stopped, but in the afternoon it is not as intensive as when the fire was concentrated in the morning.
If you are poor, you will have interspersed tactics; if you are rich, you will fire thousands of guns! Facing the rainforest in northern Vietnam, our troops are now intersecting and attacking in unison!
Liu Jimin looked in the direction of Lang Son, and then looked at Luping County behind him. Thick smoke billowed in the town of Luping County, and gunfire and cannon fire could be heard from time to time. On the horse-supporting road in the distance, a steady stream of cars transported supplies to the front line, and then pulled the wounded and loot back.
Occasionally, helicopters can be seen hovering over Luping County. For the soldiers of the 127th Division, seeing helicopters is also new.
The helicopters were not used much in the first phase, and were limited to transporting seriously injured people or the rapid transfer of command personnel.
Song Dagen stood on the battlefield, grinning widely and said: "It seems that the 55th Army will enter Lang Son for dinner at night, and they will be able to take down Hanoi in the Qingming Festival."
"Old Song, come down, don't stand so high, be careful of snipers!" Liu Jimin shouted!
Song Dagen jumped down with a smile: "Instructor, I forgot in the excitement!"
"Old Song, there's no harm in being careful!"
"hit!"
"The battalion commander is here!" Someone on the battlefield shouted, and Liu Jimin and others immediately went over to greet him.
